items.title: Magical Snowy Owl Delivering Mail
items.prompt: A magical Christmas illustration, aspect ratio 1:1.4. A fluffy white snowy owl with bright yellow eyes is in mid-flight against a dark blue, star-filled night sky. It carries a small, elegant red envelope sealed with a gold wax seal in its beak. A tiny sprig of holly is tucked behind its ear like a feather. The style is detailed and enchanting.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Sneaky Raccoons Stealing Santa's Treats
items.prompt: A funny Christmas card design, aspect ratio 1:1.4. A scene at night by a fireplace. Two sneaky raccoons wearing their natural "bandit mask" markings and tiny Santa hats are caught in the act. One is lifting a glass of milk, and the other has a chocolate chip cookie in its mouth, taken from a plate labeled 'For Santa'. Only their eyes are illuminated by the firelight. Cute, mischievous illustration style.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Penguin Skiing with Candy Canes
items.prompt: A whimsical action illustration for a Christmas card, aspect ratio 1:1.4. A cheerful penguin wearing vintage pilot goggles and a flying red scarf is skiing down a snowy slope. Instead of skis, it is using two large peppermint candy canes. Snow sprays out behind it dynamically. In the background, there are simple cartoon pine trees. Fun, dynamic cartoon style with bold outlines.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Sleeping Polar Bears
items.prompt: A heartwarming printable Christmas card, aspect ratio 1:1.4. A large mother polar bear is lying down fast asleep, curled up in a snowy drift. A tiny polar bear cub is sleeping soundly on her broad back, wearing a miniature red and green striped nightcap. A gentle snowfall surrounds them against a soft light blue background. The style is a tender children's book illustration with soft colors.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Tuxedo Cat Tangled in Ribbon
items.prompt: A funny printable Christmas card illustration, aspect ratio 1:1.4. A mischievous black and white tuxedo cat is comically tangled in a massive explosion of red satin gift ribbon and torn festive wrapping paper on a clean white background. Only its wide, surprised green eyes and one paw are visible from the center of the shiny red chaos. A roll of tape is stuck to its tail. Dynamic cartoon sketch style.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Capybara in Japanese Hot Spring
items.prompt: A relaxing and cute Christmas illustration, aspect ratio 1:1.4. A chill capybara sits peacefully up to its chest in a steaming Japanese hot spring pool (onsen), surrounded by snow-covered rocks. It wears a small folded towel on its head topped with a Santa hat. A yuzu fruit floats next to it. The style is a warm, soft anime illustration with gentle steam rising.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Singing Birds on Holly Branch
items.prompt: A cute and detailed printable Christmas card, aspect ratio 1:1.4. Five tiny, plump garden birds (a robin, a blue tit, a sparrow, a goldfinch, a wren) are perched in a row on a snow-covered holly branch with red berries. Each bird wears a different miniature knitted winter hat (bobble hat, beanie, earflap hat) and they all have their beaks open as if singing. The style is a delicate watercolor and ink drawing on textured paper.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Squirrel with Wrapped Acorn
items.prompt: A whimsical printable Christmas card, aspect ratio 1:1.4. A busy red squirrel with fluffy ear tufts stands on a snow-covered tree branch against a pale winter sky. It is holding a single acorn that is meticulously wrapped in tiny red paper with a gold bow, presenting it forward. Behind it, a pile of similarly wrapped acorns is stacked inside a hollow log. The squirrel wears a tiny green knit scarf. Colored pencil texture style.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Corgi Stuck in Chimney
items.prompt: A humorous Christmas card illustration, flat graphic style, aspect ratio 1:1.4. A red brick chimney stack stands against a dark blue night sky with stars. Stuck upside down in the top opening of the chimney is the fluffy orange and white butt of a Corgi dog, with its short back legs wiggling in the air. A tiny Santa hat is falling off one foot. Smoke puffs out around it in the shape of question marks.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Fluffy Highland Cow with Christmas Lights
items.prompt: A charming and fuzzy Christmas illustration, aspect ratio 1:1.4. A close-up portrait of a super fluffy ginger Scottish Highland cow. Its shaggy hair completely covers its eyes, but colorful tangled Christmas lights that are glowing, and small shiny red baubles, are caught in its bangs and long horns. Light snowflakes dust its fur. The background is a soft, blurred snowy pasture. Painterly, textured style.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Long Dachshund Christmas Card
items.prompt: A funny flat vector illustration for a Christmas card, aspect ratio 1:1.4. A very long brown dachshund dog stretches horizontally across the entire card against a solid pale blue background. It is wearing an absurdly long, red knitted turtleneck sweater with a repeating pattern of white reindeer and snowflakes. The sweater is so long it sags in the middle, touching the ground. The dog looks content. Text below reads: "Longing for Christmas."
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Whimsical Hedgehog Christmas Card
items.prompt: A whimsical printable Christmas card illustration, aspect ratio 1:1.4. A small, round hedgehog is curled up into a ball on a clean cream background. Its spines are hilariously covered with tiny, colorful Christmas baubles, miniature candy canes, and bits of shiny tinsel that have gotten stuck to them. The hedgehog has a slightly confused but happy expression, with one eye peeking out. The style is a gentle watercolor painting with soft textures.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Kawaii Otters with Candy Cane
items.prompt: An adorable printable Christmas card design, aspect ratio 1:1.4. Two cute furry sea otters are floating on their backs in icy blue water, holding paws. Instead of their usual rock, they are jointly holding a large red and white striped peppermint candy cane across their chests. Both wear tiny Santa hats titled on their heads. Soft white ripples surround them. The style is a kawaii cartoon with soft shading.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Santa's Laundry Line Christmas Card
items.prompt: A whimsical and domestic Christmas scene, aspect ratio 1:1.4. A clothesline made of festive tinsel is strung across a pale blue snowy sky background. Pinned to the line with wooden clothespins are Santa's iconic clothes: his big red jacket with white fur trim, his red trousers, a pair of red suspenders, and a pair of humorous white boxer shorts covered in a pattern of green holly leaves and red berries. A small bluebird is perched on the clothesline. The style is a clean, flat illustration with a paper-cut texture effect. A unique and funny take on Santa getting ready.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Pug Disguised as Elf Christmas Card
items.prompt: A funny, flat vector illustration for a Christmas card, aspect ratio 1:1.4. The image shows a horizontal lineup of four Santa's elves dressed in green tunics, red and white striped tights, and pointy hats. In the middle of the line, trying to blend in, is a beige Pug dog standing on its hind legs, wearing the exact same elf costume. The elves on either side are looking at the dog with side-eye suspicion, while the dog looks straight ahead with a blank, innocent expression. The background is a solid festive red. Text at the bottom reads: {argument name="text" default="Day 24: They still suspect nothing."} in a typewriter font.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Reindeer Flight School Christmas Card
items.prompt: A charming and funny Christmas card design, aspect ratio 1:1.4. The scene depicts a "Reindeer Flight School." A cute, clumsy baby reindeer with a slightly oversized red nose is hovering just a few inches off the snowy ground, legs splayed out in all directions, looking panicked but determined. He is wearing vintage aviator goggles and a brown leather helmet. Behind him, a tiny red robin bird is using its beak to push the reindeer's bottom to help him stay up. The background is a simple, pale blue winter sky with fluffy white clouds. The style is a detailed colored pencil drawing on textured paper.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Marshmallow Hot Tub Christmas Card
items.prompt: A kawaii style printable Christmas card illustration, aspect ratio 1:1.4. The view is a top-down perspective looking into a red ceramic mug filled with rich, brown hot chocolate. Inside the mug, three adorable white marshmallow characters are relaxing as if it's a hot tub. One marshmallow is leaning back with drawn-on sunglasses made of chocolate icing. Another is wearing a tiny candy cane snorkel. The third is floating on a square of chocolate bar like a raft. Steam swirls rise up in the shape of hearts. The background outside the mug is a soft pink with white polka dots. High resolution, bright colors, vector art style.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Hamster with Cranberry Christmas Card
items.prompt: An exquisite, printable Christmas greeting card illustration in a soft, storybook watercolor style, aspect ratio 1:1.4. The scene is a close-up macro view of a chubby, golden-brown hamster wearing a tiny, knitted red Santa hat. The hamster sits at a miniature wooden table made from a popsicle stick. He is holding a single, bright red cranberry with both paws, looking absolutely delighted with stuffed cheeks. On the table, there is a thimble serving as a cup and a tiny plate with a crumb of cheese. The background is a warm, creamy off-white paper texture with faint watercolor holly leaves in the corners. The mood is cozy, tiny, and heartwarming.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Cat in Christmas Lights Christmas Card
items.prompt: A humorous and cute printable card design, aspect ratio 1:1.4. The illustration features a chaotic, tangled mess of colorful vintage Christmas lights (red, green, blue, yellow bulbs) forming a rough ball shape in the center of a solid white background. Emerging from the center of the tangle is a cute black cat with wide, yellow eyes and a mischievous expression. The cat has one paw stuck out, batting at a loose bulb. A "To/From" gift tag is tangled in the wire, dangling from the cat's ear. The style is a flat graphic illustration with clean lines and vibrant colors. Text at the bottom: {argument name="text" default="I Helped."} in a messy, scratchy black font.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Watercolor Snowy Cabin Landscape
items.prompt: A serene watercolor landscape, --ar 10:14. A lonely cabin in a vast snowy field at sunset. The sky is a gradient of {argument name="sky color 1" default="purple"}, {argument name="sky color 2" default="pink"}, and {argument name="sky color 3" default="orange"}. Smoke rises vertically from the chimney. Soft, wet-on-wet watercolor technique.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Luxury Navy Snowflake Mandala Card
items.prompt: An exquisite luxury card design, --ar 10:14. A deep {argument name="background color" default="navy blue"} velvet texture background. In the center, a large, intricate snowflake mandala is rendered in embossed {argument name="foil color" default="gold"} foil. The {argument name="foil color" default="gold"} looks shiny and metallic.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Vintage Travel Poster Winter Scene
items.prompt: A vintage travel poster style Christmas card. A stylized view of a snowy mountain lodge with a skier. Bold flat colors, screen print texture. Text at bottom: "{argument name="message" default="Winter Wonderland"}". --ar 10:14
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Nostalgic Toy Shop Window Scene
items.prompt: A nostalgic illustration of a toy shop window at night. Inside, a toy train circles a tree, and tin soldiers stand guard. The window frame is wood, and snow gathers in the corners. Warm yellow glow from inside.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Mid-Century Modern Christmas Card
items.prompt: A retro geometric design, --ar 10:14. Mid-century modern atomic starbursts and diamond shapes in {argument name="color 1" default="gold"}, {argument name="color 2" default="turquoise"}, and {argument name="color 3" default="orange"} on a {argument name="background color" default="cream"} background. "{argument name="greeting" default="Merry Christmas"}" in a retro 50s font.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Victorian Father Christmas Postcard
items.prompt: A vintage Victorian Christmas postcard style illustration, --ar 10:14. A classic Father Christmas in a long {argument name="robe color" default="green"} robe with {argument name="trim color" default="gold"} trim walks through a snowy village carrying a lantern. Muted colors, aged paper texture, detailed cross-hatching.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Sleepy Animals Stack Christmas Card
items.prompt: A cute cartoon illustration. A stack of three sleepy animals: a {argument name="bottom animal" default="bear"} at the bottom, a {argument name="middle animal" default="fox"} in the middle, and a {argument name="top animal" default="bunny"} on top, all hibernating together under a patchwork quilt. "{argument name="message" default="Cozy & Bright"}" text in the clouds above. --ar 10:14
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Penguin Christmas Lights Struggle Card
items.prompt: A cute and funny printable Christmas card, --ar 10:14. A cartoon penguin is struggling to untangle a massive ball of colorful Christmas lights. The penguin looks frustrated but adorable. White background with soft blue snow shadows. Text: "{argument name="message" default="It's that time again..."}"
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Modern Typography Christmas Tree Card
items.prompt: A modern, flat graphic Christmas card, --ar 10:14. On a solid {argument name="background color" default="matcha green"} background, a geometric Christmas tree is formed entirely by white typography of varying weights and sizes, spelling out holiday words like "{argument name="word 1" default="Joy"}", "{argument name="word 2" default="Love"}", "{argument name="word 3" default="Noel"}", "{argument name="word 4" default="Snow"}". The overall shape is a clean triangle. Minimalist and bold.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Kawaii Hot Cocoa Christmas Card
items.prompt: A kawaii style Christmas card. A happy, smiling cup of hot cocoa with marshmallows bathing in it. The marshmallows have tiny faces. Steam rises in the shape of a heart. Pastel pink background with white polka dots. Text: "{argument name="message" default="Sending you a hug in a mug."}" --ar 10:14
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Snowman and Birds on Park Bench
items.prompt:
A beautiful and charming winter illustration, perfect for a printable greeting card. A friendly snowman with a carrot nose, coal eyes, and a smile sits on a weathered green wooden park bench partially covered in soft snow. The snowman is dressed in a dark brown fedora and a warm red and yellow patterned scarf, with twig arms resting on the bench.

A vibrant red cardinal is perched on the back of the bench. Next to the snowman sits a small burlap sack overflowing with birdseed. Several cute black-capped chickadees are happily eating seeds on the bench and on the snowy ground in the foreground.

The background shows a serene, snowy landscape with a forest of pine trees under a pale, overcast sky with large, soft snowflakes gently falling. The entire scene has a soft, painterly texture with a gentle, embossed quality, creating a heartwarming and peaceful mood.

High detail, intricate, beautiful illustration, printable quality. --ar 1:1.4
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Navy Blue Silver Filigree Card
items.prompt:
A beautiful, printable Christmas greeting card design, flat vector art style, with a 1:1.4 aspect ratio. The background is a solid, deep navy blue.

In the center, the words {argument name="greeting" default="Merry Christmas"} are written in an elegant, flowing white script font.

The text is surrounded by delicate, symmetrical filigree swirls and flourishes in light blue and silvery-gray. These decorative vines are adorned with stylized silver-gray leaves and small dots like winter berries or snow, also in light blue and silver. A simple, thin horizontal stripe in a lighter blue runs along the bottom edge.

The overall design is clean, minimalist, and sophisticated with a cool winter color palette. High resolution, sharp lines, elegant graphic illustration.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Charcoal Folk Art Botanical Card
items.prompt:
An exquisite, printable Christmas card design, presented in a frontal view.
The background is a solid dark charcoal gray with a matte paper texture.

In the center, the greeting {argument name="greeting" default="Merry Christmas"} is elegantly hand-lettered in a flowing white brush script.
The text is beautifully framed by a dense, hand-painted border of festive botanicals in a charming folk art style. This border features stylized red poinsettia flowers, dark green holly leaves with red berries, pine sprigs, and clusters of golden-yellow berries.

Light teal leafy vines are woven throughout the arrangement, providing a modern and colorful contrast. Small, simple red hearts are tucked into the design, adding a touch of warmth.

The illustration has a flat, 2D gouache on paper look, with opaque colors and a delightful handcrafted feel.

Aspect ratio 1:1.4.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Watercolor Snowman Family Portrait
items.prompt:
A beautiful, printable Christmas greeting card design in a charming watercolor style.

In the center, a delightful family of three snowmen—a father snowman in a black top hat and plaid scarf, a mother snowman in a red beanie and plaid scarf, and a small child snowman in a striped red scarf—pose happily in the snow. They are surrounded by colorful wrapped gift boxes.

Behind them stands a beautifully decorated Christmas tree with red and gold baubles and a shining star on top.

The background is a clean, solid white with delicate, light grey snowflakes gently falling.

At the top, the greeting '{argument name="Greeting" default="Merry Christmas"}' is written in an elegant, flowing black script font. Below it, the text '{argument name="Sub-greeting" default="TO A SPECIAL FAMILY"}' appears in a simple, smaller capital font.

At the bottom, personalized names '{argument name="Names" default="James Ella Claire"}' are written in the same elegant black script.

The overall design is heartwarming, clean, and festive. Flat 2D illustration, front-facing view. High resolution, intricate details, perfect for printing. --ar 1:1.4
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Personalized Snowman Family of Four
items.prompt:
A charming, flat design Christmas card illustration featuring a family of four smiling snowmen standing in a row on a snowy landscape. The style is clean, whimsical, and vector-like.

The background is a layered winter scene with a medium grey sky filled with small white dots for snow and elegant white swirls. Below the sky are two rolling hills in a lighter shade of grey.

The four snowmen are in the center. Each is made of two white snowballs and has black dot eyes, a carrot nose, and a happy smile. They are personalized with names and accessories:
The first snowman on the left wears a red beanie and has the name {argument name="name 1" default="MARK"} on its chest.
The second snowman wears red earmuffs and a red scarf, with the name {argument name="name 2" default="STACEY"}.
The third snowman wears a red pom-pom beanie and a red scarf, with the name {argument name="name 3" default="OLIVIA"}.
The fourth snowman on the right wears a red beanie, with the name {argument name="name 4" default="NATHAN"}.

Below the snowmen, in a clean white foreground area, the text "MERRY CHRISTMAS" is written in a classic black serif font.

The image is a high-resolution, exquisite, printable greeting card design. Frontal view, full-frame composition, with an aspect ratio of 1:1.4.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Rainbow Bottle Brush Trees
items.prompt:
A high-quality, printable Christmas card design in a minimalist flat illustration style, aspect ratio 1:1.4.

The design is set against a solid, very pale pink background.
At the top center, the text '{argument name="top text" default="MERRY CHRISTMAS"}' is written in a simple, clean, all-caps font. Directly below, the phrase '{argument name="bottom text" default="one and all"}' appears in a delicate, casual handwritten script.

The main illustration features a row of six stylized bottle brush Christmas trees in the lower half of the card. The trees are rendered with a sketchy, scribbled texture of dense horizontal lines. They are arranged in a vibrant rainbow color order from left to right: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple.

The trees vary slightly in height, creating a gentle, uneven line. Each tree has a simple trunk and a small, flat oval stand. The text and the tree stands are a matching muted taupe brown color. The overall design is clean, modern, and charming.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Elegant Golden Filigree Tree on Green
items.prompt:
An exquisite, printable Christmas greeting card design, aspect ratio 1:1.4. The design features a solid, deep forest green background.

Centered on the card is a beautifully stylized Christmas tree composed of intricate, swirling golden filigree and ribbons. These elegant, flowing lines and curls form the iconic triangular shape of a tree, topped with a simple loop.

The tree is lavishly decorated with small, sparkling golden stars, starbursts, and tiny dots that resemble festive lights. The golden elements have a subtle gradient giving them a shiny, metallic foil appearance.

Below the tree, the greeting '{argument name="text" default="Merry Christmas"}' is written in an elegant, flowing cursive script, matching the golden color and texture of the tree.

The overall style is modern, minimalist, and very elegant. Flat vector graphic illustration.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Personalized Family Stockings Watercolor
items.prompt:
An exquisite, printable Christmas greeting card design in a minimalist watercolor style, set against a clean, solid white background.

In the upper half of the card, a festive green pine garland hangs in a graceful arc, decorated with small red berries and soft, glowing fairy lights. A large, elegant red bow with gold trim is prominently featured at the center of the garland.

Hanging from the garland are three personalized Christmas stockings. The first stocking on the left is a {argument name="Stocking 1 Pattern" default="red tartan plaid"}, with the name {argument name="Name 1" default="Mum"} on its white cuff. The middle stocking, directly below the bow, is a {argument name="Stocking 2 Pattern" default="green tartan plaid"}, with the name {argument name="Name 2" default="Liam"} on its white cuff. The third stocking on the right is {argument name="Stocking 3 Pattern" default="red with white snowflakes"}, with the name {argument name="Name 3" default="Dad"} on its white cuff. The names are written in a simple black font.

Below the illustration, the greeting {argument name="Greeting Text" default="Merry Christmas"} is written in a beautiful, flowing red cursive script.

The overall design is a flat 2D illustration, with a balanced and centered composition. The image should be presented as a front-facing view of the card design, filling the entire frame. High resolution, perfect for printing. Aspect ratio 1:1.4.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Vintage Disney Characters Christmas
items.prompt:
An exquisite, printable Christmas greeting card featuring classic Disney characters in a vintage 2D illustration style, aspect ratio 1:1.4. The overall mood is cheerful and festive.

The scene is set against a vibrant bright green background, lightly speckled with shimmering gold glitter. In the center stands a lush Christmas tree decorated with colorful ornaments and topped with a large, shining gold glitter star.

A group of beloved Disney characters, all dressed in Santa Claus outfits with red suits and hats trimmed in white fur, are gathered around the tree. At the top left, Goofy peeks out from behind the tree, waving happily. On the upper right, Donald Duck excitedly holds a wrapped gift.

In the foreground at the bottom, Minnie Mouse stands on the left, wearing a Santa dress with a holly accent, striking a sweet, shy pose. In the center, a large red Santa's sack overflows with presents, and a joyful Pluto sits inside it, looking up at Mickey Mouse. To the right, Mickey Mouse laughs heartily, his hands on the sack.

At the very bottom of the card, there is festive text in a bold, red, sans-serif font. The first line reads {argument name="Top Text" default="CAROLS and PRESENTS"}, and the second line reads {argument name="Bottom Text" default="and TREATS by the TON!"}.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Victorian Die-Cut Floral Bouquet
items.prompt:
A beautiful, printable vintage Victorian Christmas card illustration, designed as an intricate die-cut shape. The artwork features a lush, layered bouquet of festive flowers with a classic, elegant feel.

A large, vibrant red poinsettia with delicate gold foil outlines dominates the upper part of the composition. Below it to the left rests an elegant, creamy-white poinsettia, also detailed with gold outlines and a beaded center. A rich, dark red rose with fine gold-lined petals is nestled on the right.

The arrangement is filled out with deep green holly leaves, small clusters of bright red holly berries, and sprigs of pale green mistletoe, creating a full and festive look. The overall effect is of layered, embossed papercraft with subtle shadows that give it a gentle depth.

In the bottom right, a small, decorative antique paper tag is tucked into the bouquet, displaying the text: {argument name="greeting" default="Wish you a merry Christmas"} in ornate, multi-colored calligraphy.

The entire image is a flat, front-facing view, exquisitely detailed and perfect for printing. Aspect ratio 1:1.4.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Cozy Watercolor Christmas Living Room
items.prompt:
A beautiful, printable watercolor illustration of a cozy and bright Christmas living room. The scene features a classic white fireplace on the right with a warm, roaring fire. The mantelpiece is elegantly decorated with a lush pine garland, red berries, and a festive wreath. Next to the fireplace and by a large, arched window on the left, stand small, charming Christmas trees. Soft, bright daylight streams through the window. The foreground shows a hint of a wooden chair and a soft red rug on the warm-toned floor.

The overall style is light and airy, with a soft color palette of yellows, greens, and reds, painted with delicate, expressive watercolor strokes on textured paper.

--ar 1:1.4
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Musical Note Christmas Tree
items.prompt:
A beautifully designed, printable Christmas card with a minimalist and elegant aesthetic, presented in a frontal view.

The main feature is a Christmas tree creatively formed from an assortment of black musical notes and symbols. The notes, including treble clefs, quarter notes, and eighth notes, are artfully scattered to create the triangular silhouette of the tree. Wavy, horizontal music staff lines are draped across the tree like festive garlands, with more notes arranged along them. A single, solid black star sits at the very peak of the tree.

The entire design is set against a high-quality, off-white paper background with a subtle, fine linen texture.

Centered at the bottom, below the tree, the greeting {argument name="text" default="Merry Christmas"} is written in a graceful, flowing black cursive font.

The overall style is a clean, monochrome, flat 2D graphic illustration, with a high-resolution, print-ready quality. The composition is centered to fit a 1:1.4 aspect ratio.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: 1950s Vintage Holly Wreath
items.prompt:
An exquisite, printable vintage 1950s Christmas greeting card, presented on a flat, off-white cream paper background, viewed front-on.

The card features a central, lush illustration of a holly wreath with vibrant red berries and rich, dark green spiky leaves. The artwork is a classic mid-century print illustration with clean lines and soft shading, with a subtle warm glow from behind the holly.

In the top corners, elegant red cursive script reads {argument name="Top Left Text" default="Christmas"} and {argument name="Top Right Text" default="Greetings"}.

A small white paper tag with a decorative scalloped edge is nestled among the lower leaves, attached with a simple, bright red satin bow. The tag features the message in the same red script: {argument name="Tag Text" default="AND Best Wishes FOR YOU"}.

Flat 2D graphic design, high resolution. --ar 1:1.4
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Mid-Century Flocked Tree on Blue
items.prompt:
A vintage mid-century modern Christmas card illustration featuring a stylized, flocked white Christmas tree. The tree is centered against a textured, dusty blue background with gentle falling snow.

The tree is adorned with an array of classic ornaments: round baubles in festive red and blue, sparkling gold glitter ornaments, and red-and-white striped candy canes. Each ornament hangs from a small, simple black bow. A whimsical, flowing ribbon of golden musical staff with notes gracefully swirls around the tree from top to bottom. One of the blue ornaments can feature the text {argument name='greeting' default='Happy Holidays'}.

At the base, the tree stands in a dark blue decorative pot with a gold zig-zag pattern. The artwork has a painterly, gouache-on-paper texture with a retro color palette.

Exquisite and printable design, flat graphic illustration, front view. Aspect ratio 1:1.4.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Folk Art Stockings for Special Relative
items.prompt:
A high-quality, printable Christmas greeting card illustration in a charming, whimsical flat design, aspect ratio 1:1.4.

The scene features three decorative Christmas stockings hanging in a slight diagonal line from the top against a clean off-white background. Each stocking is uniquely decorated with folk art and retro-inspired patterns, using a festive color palette of red, dark green, pink, teal, blue, and gold. The stockings have prominent gold glitter accents along their edges and on some patterns, giving them a sparkling, textured feel.

Small, stylized robins with red breasts are perched on the cuffs of the stockings, which are filled with small, wrapped gift boxes. Hanging from the top are decorative elements like strings of colorful beads, diamond-shaped garlands, and a single pink retro bauble.

The background is sprinkled with gold foil dots and starbursts, creating a magical, confetti-like atmosphere.

At the bottom of the card, the text is displayed. The phrase "{argument name="greeting line 1" default="To a"}" is in a delicate black script. Below it, the main greeting "{argument name="greeting line 2" default="WONDERFUL NIECE"}" is in a large, stylized, uppercase font. The word "WONDERFUL" is rendered in a gold foil effect, while the word "NIECE" has each letter filled with a different solid color from the card's palette.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Minimalist Rainbow Brushstroke Tree
items.prompt:
A minimalist and artistic Christmas card design featuring a stylized Christmas tree on a solid white background. The tree is formed by expressive, textured, painterly brushstrokes arranged in horizontal bands of rainbow colors, starting with red at the top, followed by orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple at the base. A simple, solid red star sits on top of the tree.

Below the tree, the text '{argument name="text" default="Merry Christmas"}' is written in a delicate, elegant black cursive script. The overall aesthetic is modern, clean, and festive. High-quality printable illustration, flat design. --ar 1:1.4
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Van Gogh Starry Night Christmas
items.prompt:
A beautiful Christmas painting in the style of Vincent van Gogh's "The Starry Night".

In the foreground on the left, a large, magnificent green Christmas tree is decorated with an array of glowing, colorful lights and topped with a shining star.
To the right, a quaint and cozy village with a prominent church steeple is nestled amongst dark, rolling hills. The small houses glow with warm lights from their windows and are draped in festive decorations.
The sky above is a dramatic, swirling vortex of deep blues, cyans, and whites, filled with luminous yellow stars that have radiant halos. A large, brilliant Star of Bethlehem shines brightly in the upper right corner, casting a golden light.

The entire scene is rendered with thick, expressive impasto brushstrokes, creating a sense of dynamic movement and rich texture.
Vibrant colors, highly detailed, exquisite, printable quality. --ar 5:7
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Peanuts Style Snoopy and Stockings
items.prompt:
An exquisite, printable Christmas greeting card illustration in the charming, flat 2D style of Peanuts, with a 1:1.4 aspect ratio. The entire scene is presented from a frontal view against a soft cream-colored background with a subtle paper texture.

On the right, a cheerful Snoopy peeks out from a large Christmas stocking. The stocking is teal with a darker teal diamond pattern and has a bright lime green cuff, heel, and toe. Snoopy is holding a red and white striped candy cane. To his left hangs a smaller, red Christmas stocking with a pink diamond pattern, from which a slightly frazzled Woodstock is peeking out, with another candy cane next to him.

In the top left corner, whimsical, multi-colored, hand-drawn text reads: {argument name="joke setup" default="WHAT DID ONE CHRISTMAS STOCKING SAY TO THE OTHER?"}. The text is surrounded by simple, colorful starbursts.

The bottom of the card features a large, stylized lime green Christmas tree on the left, and a collection of brightly colored gift boxes in pink, green, and teal. On the far right at the bottom, there is a row of three small, simple teal Christmas tree shapes. The entire illustration uses a festive and bright color palette of red, pink, lime green, and teal.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Whimsical Watercolor Stocking Garland
items.prompt:
A charming, printable greeting card design in a 1:1.4 aspect ratio. The card features a whimsical, hand-drawn watercolor illustration with a naive art style, set against a soft, light pink textured paper background.

Stretching horizontally across the upper portion is a delicate green pine needle garland. Six colorful, mismatched socks hang from the garland, each drawn with fine black ink lines and filled with vibrant watercolor. The socks are, from left to right: a red sock with thick white stripes and a tan heel and toe; a white speckled sock with a green toe; a sock with thin brown horizontal stripes and red accents; a vibrant green sock featuring a white Christmas tree silhouette; a simple red sock with a pink toe; and a blue sock adorned with white snowflakes.

Below the garland, the text '{argument name="text" default="Season's Greetings"}' is centered in a classic red serif font.

The entire composition is flat, 2D, centered, and viewed from the front, creating an exquisite and cheerful holiday card perfect for printing.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Mid-Century Winter Forest with Lyrics
items.prompt:
A beautifully printable Christmas card illustration in a flat, mid-century modern graphic design style.

The image features a stylized winter forest scene under a gentle snowfall. The background is a light, dusty blue with a subtle speckled texture throughout.

In the lower two-thirds of the image, there is a dense forest of stylized trees. Some trees are tall, skinny, dark grey triangles with horizontal white lines representing snow on the branches. Interspersed are broader, light sage-green triangular trees, which contain minimalist dark grey trunks and branches adorned with small red berries. The trees are layered, creating a sense of depth in the flat design.

White specks representing falling snow are scattered across the entire image, contributing to a vintage, screen-printed texture.

In the upper left, the text is displayed in a classic, dark grey serif font:
{argument name="text" default="“I'm dreaming of a white Christmas\nWith every Christmas card I write\nMay your days be merry and bright\nAnd may all your Christmases be white”"}

The overall aesthetic is charming and nostalgic, using a limited color palette of dusty blue, dark grey, sage green, white, and red.
High resolution, vector art, aspect ratio 1:1.4.
items.author: Jared Liu

items.title: Modern Rainbow Pride Christmas Tree
items.prompt:
A beautiful, printable Christmas card design in a modern, flat graphic style. The card features a textured, deep navy blue background.

Centered on the card is a stylized Christmas tree made of horizontal stripes in the colors of the rainbow pride flag: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and lavender. The tree is topped with a simple, bright yellow star and has a small brown trunk at its base.

Below the tree, the message {argument name="text" default="MERRY CHRISTMAS TO ALL!"} is written in a clean, elegant, golden-yellow sans-serif font.

The overall aesthetic is minimalist, inclusive, and festive. Frontal view of the card cover, high resolution, sharp details. --ar 1:1.4
